name: Modifier Grid Demo
description: A proof of the grid MODIFIER STACK: a flat plane of cells with a non-destructive, ordered op-stack (colorize, random_colors with a seed, shift, normalize) applied on top. Demonstrates the proposed `modifiers` section of map_data.json — deterministic, seeded (predictable), previewable, undo = pop. The bracelet's editing made reproducible. See doc/BRACELET_GARDEN_MODIFIERS.md.
theoreticalGrounding: A modifier is not a thing in a cell but an operation over cells; the ordered stack is the trace of care (the lambda-tending log). colorize/random push variety (E), normalize pulls toward order (F).
